mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO inventory_allocation_flow (pool_segment, pool_inv_id, award_id, quantity, alloc_biz_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{poolSegment}, #{poolInvId}, #{awardId}, #{quantity}, #{allocBizId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_allocation_flow WHERE alloc_biz_id = #{allocBizId})
